cases.sentence: Но ___ нашел милость в глазах Господа.
cases.translation: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.
cases.explain: Ной is the subject of нашёл (found), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Но Ной нашел милость в глазах ___.
cases.translation: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.
cases.explain: The genitive case here expresses possession — 'the eyes of the Lord.'

cases.sentence: Введи в ковчег всех живых существ по ___, самца и самку, чтобы они остались в живых вместе с тобой.
cases.translation: Bring into the ark two of every living creature, male and female, that they may stay alive with you.
cases.explain: The preposition по in its distributive sense ('in pairs') governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я наведу на ___ воды потопа, чтобы погубить все, что живет под небом.
cases.translation: I will bring the floodwaters on the earth, to destroy all that lives under the sky.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating motion onto something governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он ходил с ___. У Ноя было трое сыновей — Сим, Хам и Иофет.
cases.translation: He walked with God. Noah had three sons — Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Everything that is on the earth will perish.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location (not motion) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Люди начали умножаться на земле, и у них стали рождаться дочери.
reading.question: What began to happen as people multiplied on the earth?
options: Daughters began to be born to them
reading.correct: Daughters began to be born to them
reading.explain: The text says as people multiplied, 'у них стали рождаться дочери' — daughters began to be born to them.

reading.ru: Господь пожалел, что сотворил человека на земле, и сердце его наполнилось болью.
reading.question: How did God feel about having made humanity?
options: He regretted it and was filled with pain
reading.correct: He regretted it and was filled with pain
reading.explain: The text says God 'пожалел, что сотворил человека... и сердце его наполнилось болью' — regretted making man and his heart was filled with pain.

reading.ru: Среди людей того времени лишь только Ной был праведен и безупречен.
reading.question: What made Noah stand out among the people of his time?
options: He alone was righteous and blameless
reading.correct: He alone was righteous and blameless
reading.explain: The text says 'лишь только Ной был праведен и безупречен' — only Noah was righteous and blameless.

reading.ru: Ковчег должен быть с 300 локтей в длину, 50 локтей в ширину и 30 локтей в высоту.
reading.question: What were the dimensions of the ark God commanded Noah to build?
options: 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, 30 cubits high
100 cubits long, 20 cubits wide, 10 cubits high
500 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, 50 cubits high
300 cubits long, 100 cubits wide, 30 cubits high
reading.correct: 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, 30 cubits high
reading.explain: The text gives the ark's size as '300 локтей в длину, 50 локтей в ширину и 30 локтей в высоту.'

reading.ru: Введи в ковчег всех живых существ по паре, самца и самку, чтобы они остались в живых вместе с тобой.
reading.question: How many of each living creature was Noah told to bring into the ark?
reading.explain: God tells Noah to bring 'по паре, самца и самку' — a pair, male and female, of each creature.
